headline: Sheinbaum denies that Trump spoke about the cartels at the APEC meeting
summary: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said her bilateral meeting with Donald Trump at APEC focused exclusively on trade matters. She attributed Trump's remarks on cartels to an earlier phone call.
why: Trade and security relations between Mexico and the United States shape tariffs, supply chains and investor sentiment toward Mexico.
original_headline: Sheinbaum niega que Trump hablara de los cárteles en reunión de la APEC
